newsitem.title: USA: NetVantage says Baker resigns as CFO.
newsitem.headline: NetVantage says Baker resigns as CFO.

text.p: NetVantage Inc on Friday said Thomas Baker, 55, resigned from all his positions with the company, including vice president/finance, chief financial officer, secretary and a board member.
In his letter of resignation, tendered on Thursday, January 23, Baker indicated that he would assist the company in a transition period. Baker joined the company in October 1994.
Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Stephen R. Rizzone said that the company will commence a search for a new chief financial officer immediately.
